objective: Complete the six requested Woozy extension areas on Linux x86_64 and establish evidence-based compiler self-hosting readiness.
parallel_work: No fixed three-worker bridge limit. Parallelize independent file owners within live provider/service limits; shared compiler files retain one writer.

decisions.platform: Linux x86_64; no other native target in this goal
decisions.external_dependencies: Explicit opt-in; core executables remain freestanding, selected foreign libraries may require hosted dependencies
decisions.closures: Creation-time value capture; managed references share objects; explicit move transfers ownership; no automatic borrowed captures
decisions.memory: Weak references and automatic pure-Woozy strong-cycle collection; foreign Python/C cycles remain host-managed
decisions.generics: Ordinary type parameters and trait constraints; no C++ template metaprogramming
decisions.capture_bindings: Read-only captured bindings; shared referenced objects remain mutable through their APIs
decisions.move_capture_syntax: move func(...) { ... }; move every actually captured owning value, ordinary func copies
decisions.weak_targets: Vec, function values, ARC shared handles and std/box.Box[T]; exclude value structs/enums, string, fd wrappers and foreign Python/C objects
decisions.bound_move_receiver: Bound move-Self methods are repeatable: copy receiver by ordinary value rules before every call, then transfer that copy; reject noncopyable receivers; no once-only function type

tasks.title: HTTP/1.1 codecs, client and server transport
acceptance: Binary bodies, persistent reader and pipelining, chunked framing and trailers, bodyless responses
Reject conflicting framing, invalid headers, premature EOF and configured size limits before allocation
Real Woozy O0/O2 client/server tests and independent socket fixtures

tasks.title: TLS and HTTPS with explicit dependencies
tasks.owner: Pi implementation; Root cleanup/token fixes; independent review and integration
acceptance: Typed TLS client/server and HTTPS using a maintained TLS implementation
Certificate chain and hostname checks enabled by default; failure and nonblocking progress tested
Explicit library mode; standalone core ELF remains independent; real interoperable local client/server tests

tasks.title: Timed waits, reader-writer locks and cooperative cancellation
acceptance: Timed thread join and condition wait distinguish timeout from completion
Reader-writer lock with defined ownership and progress rules
Cooperative cancellation preserves language cleanup and does not asynchronously kill a thread

tasks.title: Channels and thread pools
acceptance: Typed bounded and unbounded channels with documented close, drain, timeout and cancellation behavior
Thread pool with task results, bounded submission, shutdown and cleanup
Contention, error, close races and ownership checked with real source programs

tasks.title: Async functions, await and task execution
acceptance: Actual compiler lowering of async/await with typed errors and cleanup across suspension
Tasks run on a documented executor; cancellation and shutdown release suspended frames
Linux event waiting and asynchronous network operations exercised by real programs

tasks.title: Capturing closures and bound method values
tasks.owner: root shared ABI; Pi implementation after published representation
acceptance: Value and explicit-move capture semantics match user decisions
Escaping environments retain values correctly and clean exactly once on normal and error exits
Function values and bound receiver values work in containers, callbacks and threads

tasks.title: Dynamic trait objects
acceptance: Declared trait object type, method dispatch, copy/move/drop and generic trait identities
Object-safe signatures checked; ambiguous implementations are rejected
Native and Python behavior and invalid HIR checks

tasks.title: Slice views, typed pointers and richer mutable places
tasks.owner: Root native/Python Slice integrated; richer inout pending
acceptance: Borrowed Slice views have explicit lifetime and mutation rules and cannot outlive storage
Typed Ptr access is restricted to explicit unsafe operations with defined ownership at FFI boundaries
Field/index inout and owning mutable places reject overlapping accesses and preserve error cleanup

tasks.title: User-defined iteration
acceptance: Iterator trait supports for-in for user-defined types and containers without forcing a Vec snapshot
Iteration type ambiguity, mutation and lifetime rules checked
Existing Vec/string iteration behavior preserved

tasks.title: Weak references
acceptance: Typed weak downgrade/upgrade with atomic liveness and no resurrection after destruction
Last strong/weak cleanup is correct across racing threads and nested values
Weak handles never keep the referent alive and cannot access reclaimed storage

tasks.title: Pure-Woozy cycle collection
acceptance: Automatically reclaim unreachable pure-Woozy cycles without collecting live roots
Trace container, aggregate and closure edges; synchronize with mutators and runtime blocking calls
Do not claim collection of foreign Python/C cycles; stress normal/error/thread/fork cleanup

tasks.title: Native C ABI and explicit hosted-library mode
acceptance: Declared C ABI functions, supported aggregate layout and typed pointer/buffer arguments
Explicit linkage, correct libc startup/TLS/thread handling when hosted libraries are selected
Callbacks and foreign resources have defined ownership and error behavior; core no-libc tests remain unchanged
Independent C fixture and real external-library programs execute on Linux x86_64

tasks.title: Python properties, indexing and slicing
acceptance: Declared typed property/index/slice operations with no fallback to unknown Any
Host identity, setters, exceptions and escaping values obey source ownership rules
Independent NumPy/PyTorch and custom-host examples execute; unsupported undeclared operations still diagnose

tasks.title: Unicode normalization, case folding and graphemes
acceptance: NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD and complete default case folding with a pinned Unicode version
Stateful extended grapheme boundaries including emoji and embedded NUL; existing codepoint indexing unchanged
Official normalization/folding/grapheme data and real source-level APIs; native core remains freestanding

tasks.title: Named time zones and daylight saving
acceptance: Named zone loading and validated TZif parsing including post-table rules
UTC/local conversion, offsets and DST across historical/future transitions
Ambiguous and nonexistent local times have explicit behavior; compare independent zoneinfo fixtures

tasks.title: Compiler self-hosting readiness and stage criteria
acceptance: Concrete source/library/tool requirements for writing the compiler in Woozy, distinguished from conveniences
Executable compiler-like probe exercises lexing, symbol data, file output and LLVM/tool invocation
Full self-hosting criterion is stage0 to stage1 to stage2 of the same Woozy compiler sources with semantic/regression comparison; a wrapper around the C++ compiler does not count
